registration_rule: Every family, specification budget, horizon, target, construction, gate, threshold, cadence grid, calibration test and verdict rule below was written BEFORE any campaign number was computed. Nothing here may be edited after a result is observed. A hypothesis that occurs to the researcher after seeing results is registered as a NEW protocol version with an explicit disclosure of what had already been seen. Thresholds are inherited from the existing owners (R57/R58/R59/R63/R64) and may not be relaxed.

2026-09-10T18:21Z, BEFORE any product number was computed and DISCLOSED: the book-level forecast calibration test is registered. A book-level expected return is licensed only if the estimate a forecaster could have formed on SELECTION periods survives the LOCKBOX on all three counts - the two layer means share a sign, the lockbox mean lies inside a 95 % predictive interval of width 1.96 * sd_selection * sqrt(1/n_s + 1/n_l) around the selection mean, and the lockbox carries at least MIN_EFFECTIVE_PERIODS observations - otherwise the field is UNAVAILABLE with the reason. Passing licenses the FULL-sample out-of-sample mean as the point forecast and the uncertainty travels with it. This adds a test; it moves no threshold and relaxes no gate.

incumbent_baseline.shape: 0.5 x z(fundamental composite) + 0.5 x z(momentum 126-21) within the eligible cross-section, the R58 B0 diagnostic shape
incumbent_baseline.fundamental_leg_reconstruction: PIT rebuild from owned SEC companyfacts on PANEL-F: z(fcf_to_assets) + z(-accruals_to_assets), the R58 a1_composite; the operational composite_sn panel is survivorship-biased and stale (R58 finding) and is NOT used as evidence
incumbent_baseline.momentum_leg_reconstruction: EXACT: 126-session total return skipping the last 21 sessions
incumbent_baseline.universe: R63 equity eligibility (PIT S&P 500 member, unadjusted close >= 5, 63-session median dollar volume >= 10M, >= 234 of 260 prior sessions) AND a PANEL-F core fundamental record
incumbent_baseline.cadence_rule: min(horizon, 21) sessions, from 2011-07-01 (PANEL-F first honest formation), the R63 rule
incumbent_baseline.books: long-only equal-weight top-25 (operational) and top-50 (shadow ledger) versus the equal-weight eligible universe, 12.5bp per side on one-way turnover, NEXT_CLOSE entry
incumbent_baseline.statistics: per-period Spearman rank IC, top-minus-bottom decile spread, net and gross excess return, Sharpe of excess, maximum drawdown of book and benchmark, one-way turnover, hit rate, Newey-West t with lag ceil(h/cadence)-1, effective non-overlapping periods, 3-year blocks, trend-up/down regimes, selection (< 2023) versus lockbox (>= 2023) split, leg attribution (fundamental-only, momentum-only, blend)
incumbent_baseline.calibration: score decile -> mean forward excess return curve; the incumbent emits a RANK SCORE and no expected return, so expected-return calibration is reported UNAVAILABLE unless a monotone, out-of-sample calibrated mapping exists
incumbent_baseline.true_forward_evidence: the desk ledgers forward_prediction_outcomes.json (matured TRUE_FORWARD sessions since 2026-07-24 at h = 1, 5, 20) and forward_performance.json (the realised alpha_paper_book_1 path since 2026-07-22), READ ONLY, reported SEPARATELY and never pooled with historical evidence

verdict_rule.INCUMBENT_HAS_MATERIAL_ALPHA: at the operational horizon (21 sessions, top-25 book) historical OOS net excess >= 0.015/yr with Newey-West t >= 2.0 AND lockbox net excess sign agrees with selection AND rank-IC t >= 2.0
verdict_rule.INCUMBENT_NEGATIVE_ALPHA_EVIDENCE: at the operational horizon net excess < 0 with Newey-West t <= -2.0, or rank-IC t <= -2.0
verdict_rule.true_forward_cannot_decide: the TRUE_FORWARD sample (tens of sessions) is reported but cannot move the verdict; it is a separate gate

forecast_contract.rule: every economic field is VALUE with an out-of-sample calibration record or UNAVAILABLE with a reason; probabilities lie in [0, 1] and up + down = 1; a score is carried as a labelled score and can never populate expected_return; research only, not wired into capital allocation

earnings_event_reaction.hypothesis: the market under-reacts to earnings news: the announcement-window abnormal return and the standardised earnings surprise predict the cross-section of subsequent returns (post-earnings-announcement drift), information the incumbent's monthly fundamental leg (TTM levels, filed weeks after the release) and its momentum leg (126-21 sessions) do not carry at the event horizon
earnings_event_reaction.sources: OWNED: SEC submissions histories (842 PANEL-F issuers, acceptance-stamped 8-K filings, R63 acquisition) and the SEC companyfacts store (NetIncomeLoss, 10-Q / 10-K / 8-K facts with filed dates); the R57 PIT price panel and SPY
earnings_event_reaction.announcement_date_rule: for each (cik, fiscal period end): the filed date of the earliest NetIncomeLoss fact reported on an 8-K for that period end if one exists (XBRL earnings release); otherwise the earliest 8-K filed between period_end + 10 calendar days and the periodic (10-Q/10-K) filing date, at most period_end + 75 days; no period without a candidate 8-K is assigned
earnings_event_reaction.event_session_rule: acceptance timestamp on or before 09:30 (as stamped) -> the event session is the first session on or after the filing date; later -> the first session strictly after it; the 3-session reaction window is [event - 1, event + 1] and is known at the close of event + 1
features: ear: 3-session log return of the stock minus SPY over the reaction window, carried for 63 sessions after the event, NaN thereafter

sue: (quarterly NetIncomeLoss - same quarter a year earlier) / std of the last 8 seasonal differences (min 4), quarterly values from ~90-day facts and Q4 = annual - 9-month YTD; available at the fact's own filed date + 1 session; carried for 63 sessions
sessions_since_event: sessions since the event, capped at 126
earnings_event_reaction.pit: every feature is placed on the grid at its own availability instant (market close for ear; filed date + 1 session for sue), never earlier; no current data is inserted into history
earnings_event_reaction.cells: the ONE scorer (alpha_agent.r63.sensitivity.run_cell, keep_predictions) with baseline = INCUMBENT_SCORE (the fixed 50/50 blend, so the baseline arm's ranking IS the incumbent's ranking) and dimension = EARNINGS_EVENT_REACTION at 1, 5, 21, 63 sessions; plus ear-only and sue-only at 21 sessions; the same dimension is ALSO measured conditional on the full R63 equity baseline at 21 sessions as the frontier-consistent information test (counted in the denominator)
earnings_event_reaction.identical_sample_rule: both arms share rows, dates, realised returns, folds, forced ridge penalty, universe, costs and construction

head_to_head_tournament.same_domain_books: long-only equal-weight top-25 and top-50 by OOS score versus the equal-weight eligible universe, 12.5bp per side, identical rows for incumbent and challenger

gates_frozen.materiality: challenger minus incumbent net excess >= 0.015/yr (R57/R58/R59/R63 floor)
gates_frozen.significance: paired Newey-West t >= 2.0 on per-period net differences
gates_frozen.lockbox: the paired advantage sign agrees between selection (< 2023) and lockbox (>= 2023) periods
gates_frozen.halves: both halves of the lockbox paired advantage >= -0.005/yr (R58)
gates_frozen.drawdown: challenger book max drawdown >= 1.5 x incumbent book max drawdown (R58 multiple)
gates_frozen.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.10 over every executed same-domain paired p-value in this campaign AND Holm alpha 0.05 within the family's horizons
gates_frozen.information: the R63 conditional increment t >= 2.0 and residual share >= 0.35 (DISTINCT)

verdicts: BEATS_INCUMBENT_NOT_QUALIFIED (materiality met, a gate failed - named)
head_to_head_tournament.cross_domain: incumbent-only (the top-25 OOS book, monthly) versus incumbent + sleeve at EQUAL TOTAL RISK: the sleeve's returns are compounded onto the incumbent's decision grid, the combination is scaled to the incumbent-only realised volatility, and the increment in net return, Sharpe and drawdown is reported with a paired Newey-West t; positive incremental utility after costs is required
head_to_head_tournament.post_selection_disclosure: the FX carry and cross-asset trend lockboxes were viewed by R63/R64; their historical results here are POST-SELECTION evidence and are labelled so

cadence_grid.hypothesis: signal observation frequency != required trading frequency: a daily-observed cross-sectional signal traded every k sessions with a no-trade band keeps most of its information and sheds most of its cost drag
cadence_grid.owner: alpha_agent/alpha_recovery/cadence.py using alpha_agent.r64.construction pieces on the ONE scorer's kept OOS scores
cadence_grid.verdict_ladder: the R64 ladder verbatim (NO_CONDITIONAL_VALUE / NOT_ECONOMIC_UNDER_CONTROLS / ECONOMIC_UNDER_CONTROLS_UNSTABLE / _NOT_FDR / ECONOMIC_UNDER_CONTROLS) with the R64 degeneracy rule; the conditional statistic is the R63 cell's and is NOT re-tested by cadence
cadence_grid.selection_rule: the cadence taken to the cross-domain test is the one with the highest augmented-book Sharpe on SELECTION periods only; its LOCKBOX result is reported once
cadence_grid.multiplicity: Holm within each family over the cadence specifications' economic p-values; campaign BH over all

market_direction.target: SPY total return (owned Norgate, 1993-), the canonical US equity market target
market_direction.features: price state (21-, 63-session return, 252-21 trend, 21/252 vol ratio, 252-session drawdown), VOLATILITY_EXPECTATIONS_IV, CREDIT_CONDITIONS, TERM_STRUCTURE, RATES_EXPECTATIONS, INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS, FUNDING_LIQUIDITY_CONDITIONS, MACRO_CHANGE, MACRO_SURPRISES, RISK_APPETITE from alpha_agent.r63.features.market_conditioner_blocks (PIT by declared lag / vintage), plus CFTC ES speculative net positioning (6-day publication lag)

models.climatology: training base rate (the honest no-information baseline)
models.probability: L2-regularised logistic regression on training-standardised features, penalty by blocked inner CV on log loss, refit on R63 yearly expanding folds with purge and embargo, lockbox 2023+
models.expected_return: ridge regression on the same features; uncertainty = training residual standard deviation

metrics: Brier score and Brier skill score against climatology
calibration bins (10) and expected calibration error
realised OOS return by forecast tercile
economic: overlay A (hold SPY when p >= training base rate, else cash) and overlay B (exposure = clip(p / base rate, 0, 1)) at 1bp per side versus buy-and-hold; paired Newey-West t

verdicts.CALIBRATED_DIRECTIONAL_SKILL: Brier skill > 0 with Newey-West t >= 2 on per-period Brier differences AND expected calibration error <= 0.05 AND >= 60 % of yearly folds with positive skill
verdicts.PROFITABLE_NOT_CALIBRATED: an overlay beats buy-and-hold net with t >= 2 but the calibration condition fails
verdicts.CALIBRATED_NOT_PROFITABLE: calibration passes but no overlay beats buy-and-hold

purchase_case.rule: no purchase, subscription, trial or account during the campaign; information need first, provider second; every paid candidate carries the R63 break-even arithmetic (fee / NAV + trading cost by horizon + half the expected gross increment + 10 % of fee / NAV) against the live paper NAV read from the desk ledger; BUY_TEST only when the expected incremental net P&L exceeds the break-even alpha after the haircut
purchase_case.news_audit: a bounded READ-ONLY depth probe of the entitled EODHD news endpoint (a handful of symbols, historical from/to windows, one delisted ticker) measures history depth and survivorship coverage before any acquisition is planned

forward_competition.rule: a candidate that clears the frozen gates is written as an immutable record with a freeze_record_hash over its complete specification (alpha_agent.r64.challenger shape), never registered automatically; the exact human-gated command (scripts/adopt_prospective_freeze.py with --confirm ADOPT_PROSPECTIVE_FORWARD_CLOCKS --execute) is printed for review

equity_construction.question: does the incumbent's OWN information do better under a different construction - a slower rebalance, or one leg instead of the blend?
equity_construction.book: long-only equal-weight top-25 daily capital path; positions drift between rebalances; a held name whose return stops printing is carried at zero until the next rebalance sells it; 12.5 bp per side on the summed absolute weight change
equity_construction.benchmark: the equal-weight scored universe rebalanced every 21 sessions, FIXED across arms
equity_construction.comparison: paired non-overlapping 21-session blocks against the operational k21 arm, Newey-West lag from the slower arm
equity_construction.ladder_not_extended: the cadence ladder stops at 126 sessions; it is NOT extended after observing that the point estimate rises with the cadence

frontier_residual.question: are the OWNED needs the frontier still ranks highest worth anything, measured rather than assumed?
frontier_residual.threshold_discipline: sensitivity.MIN_ROWS stays at 200; the VOLATILITY DATA_HOLD is answered by a cadence that yields enough decision slots, never by a lower floor
frontier_residual.owners: futures scopes through alpha_agent.r64.experiments.measure_cell verbatim; the equity and credit-proxy scopes compose the SAME scorer and book around the R63 assembler

forecast_products.question: what can this estate predict today, in economic units?
forecast_products.calibration_test: sign agreement between the selection and lockbox means AND the lockbox mean inside a 95 % predictive interval around the selection mean AND at least MIN_EFFECTIVE_PERIODS lockbox observations; otherwise UNAVAILABLE with the reason
forecast_products.on_passing: the FULL-sample out-of-sample mean is the point forecast and its Newey-West t travels with it; a licensed small edge is published WITH its t, never dressed up
